<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="headerGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="buttonGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="screenClip">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <g clip-path="url(#screenClip)">
    <!-- Gradient profile header -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="238" fill="url(#headerGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="54" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18"/>
    <polyline points="48,48 40,54 48,60" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="60" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>

    <!-- store icon -->
    <g>
      <rect x="331" y="39" width="34" height="30" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18"/>
      <rect x="338" y="48" width="20" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="336,48 339,42 357,42 360,48" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="48" x2="348" y2="63" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="338" y1="53" x2="358" y2="53" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>

    <!-- status bar -->
    <text x="20" y="23" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="20" x2="325" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="300" y="17" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="305" y="15" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="310" y="13" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="315" y="11" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="332" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="22" x2="336" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="347" y="12" width="23" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="370" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="349" y="14" width="16" height="7" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- avatar -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="119" r="57" fill="#000000" opacity=".12"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="114" r="55" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="114" r="51" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="96" r="17" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="135" rx="30" ry="18" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="114" r="51" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="195" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">John, 29</text>
    <text x="195" y="213" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".92">New York, NY</text>

    <!-- profile content -->
    <rect x="16" y="224" width="358" height="78" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="221" width="358" height="78" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="32" y="246" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Complete your profile</text>
    <text x="32" y="267" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Stand out and get more matches</text>
    <rect x="32" y="279" width="236" height="7" rx="4" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="32" y="279" width="165" height="7" rx="4" fill="url(#buttonGradient)"/>
    <text x="337" y="286" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">70%</text>

    <text x="20" y="335" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Edit profile</text>
    <text x="370" y="335" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Preview</text>

    <!-- photo card -->
    <rect x="16" y="351" width="358" height="133" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="348" width="358" height="133" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="29" y="361" width="91" height="106" rx="10" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="101" cy="372" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82"/>
    <circle cx="101" cy="372" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <polygon points="39,451 62,426 75,439 88,423 111,451" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="386" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7"/>
    <text x="137" y="379" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Photos</text>
    <text x="137" y="401" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Add up to 6 photos</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="137" y="419" width="103" height="32" rx="16" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="158" y1="435" x2="170" y2="435" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="164" y1="429" x2="164" y2="441" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="181" y="439" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Add photos</text>
    </g>

    <!-- about card -->
    <rect x="16" y="497" width="358" height="155" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="494" width="358" height="155" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="32" y="523" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">About John</text>
    <text x="357" y="523" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Edit</text>
    <line x1="32" y1="536" x2="358" y2="536" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="32" y="562" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Bio</text>
    <text x="32" y="584" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Coffee enthusiast, weekend explorer,</text>
    <text x="32" y="604" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">and always up for a good conversation.</text>
    <text x="32" y="631" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">28 / 500 characters</text>

    <!-- details header -->
    <text x="20" y="691" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My details</text>

    <!-- details rows -->
    <rect x="16" y="708" width="358" height="172" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="737" r="15" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="733" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="42" cy="743" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="70" y="735" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Name</text>
    <text x="70" y="753" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">John Miller</text>
    <polyline points="350,735 355,740 350,745" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="70" y1="769" x2="358" y2="769" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <circle cx="42" cy="799" r="15" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <rect x="35" y="791" width="14" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="795" x2="46" y2="795" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="70" y="797" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Job title</text>
    <text x="70" y="815" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Product Designer</text>
    <polyline points="350,797 355,802 350,807" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- extending content below viewport -->
    <line x1="32" y1="831" x2="358" y2="831" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="70" y="858" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Company</text>
    <text x="70" y="877" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Independent</text>
    <text x="20" y="927" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Interests</text>
    <rect x="20" y="944" width="92" height="31" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <text x="66" y="964" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Travel</text>
    <rect x="120" y="944" width="104" height="31" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <text x="172" y="964" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Live music</text>
    <rect x="232" y="944" width="86" height="31" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <text x="275" y="964" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Cooking</text>

    <!-- fixed bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="775" width="390" height="69" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="775" x2="390" y2="775" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- discover -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="39" cy="799" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="43,795 40,802 33,805 36,798" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="39" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <!-- likes -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="117,791 121,798 129,799 123,804 125,812 117,808 110,812 111,804 105,799 113,798" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="117" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
    </g>
    <!-- matches -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="798" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="188" cy="795" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="202" cy="795" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="195" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
    </g>
    <!-- chat -->
    <g>
      <rect x="263" y="789" width="23" height="17" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="268,806 267,811 274,806" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="270" cy="798" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="275" cy="798" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="280" cy="798" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="275" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Chat</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="351" cy="797" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="351" cy="794" r="3.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
      <ellipse cx="351" cy="803" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
      <text x="351" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
    </g>

    <!-- home indicator -->
    <rect x="142" y="836" width="106" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
